headline: Singapore bond issuance last year hits record US$95 billion high, up 21.8% year on year
summary: Singapore corporate bond issuance rose 10% year on year to 339 billion yuan, a record. Outstanding corporate bonds grew 6.8% to 659 billion yuan, driven by regional demand tied to AI and infrastructure.
why: Singapore is a major Asian debt-capital market hub, and its corporate bond volumes show regional financing demand for investment and infrastructure.
